test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_slice_stale ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS samples_bucket_step_seconds = 3600, recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_slice_stale (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'cpu_seconds_total' AS metric_name, map('host', concat('h', toString(series_id % 30)), 'cpu', toString(intDiv(series_id, 30))) AS tags, arrayMap( i -> (toDateTime64(604800 + bucket_id * 3600 + i * 15, 3, 'UTC'), toFloat64(bucket_id * 240 + i)), range(240) ) AS samples FROM ( SELECT intDiv(number, 168) AS series_id, number % 168 AS bucket_id FROM numbers(300 * 168) )
test.query: SELECT count() FROM prometheusQueryRange(ts_slice_stale, 'rate(cpu_seconds_total[5m])', 604800, 1209600, 600) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM prometheusQueryRange(ts_slice_stale, 'sum by (host) (rate(cpu_seconds_total[5m]))', 604800, 1209600, 600) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM prometheusQueryRange(ts_slice_stale, 'increase(cpu_seconds_total[1h])', 604800, 1209600, 600) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM prometheusQueryRange(ts_slice_stale, 'cpu_seconds_total', 604800, 1209600, 600) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(timeSeriesSliceSortedArray(samples, toDateTime64(605000, 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64(1209000, 3, 'UTC')))) FROM timeSeriesSamples(ts_slice_stale) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(timeSeriesSliceSortedArray(samples, toDateTime64(0, 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64(2000000, 3, 'UTC')))) FROM timeSeriesSamples(ts_slice_stale) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM prometheusQuery(ts_slice_stale, 'cpu_seconds_total[1h]', 700000) FORMAT Null
